#### function

```{r}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Stan model- No Borrowing
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

# Define Stan Model Code for Piecewise Constant Hazard Model
stan.no.borrow <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
}

parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda; // Hazard rates for each interval
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2;   
}

model {
  // Priors
  lambda ~ gamma(0.0001, 0.0001);          // Prior for hazard rates
  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);
  
  // Likelihood: Poisson trick for piecewise constant hazard model
  status ~ poisson(interval_length .* lambda[interval_idx] .* exp(beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));

}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log(lambda[interval_idx[nn]]) + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Stan model- NPP Unbound
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
stan.npp.unb <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)

  int<lower=0> D1;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D2;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D3;                  // Total event in each interval
 
  real<lower=0> T1;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T2;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T3;             // Total interval length within each interval
}

parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda; // Hazard rates for each interval
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2; 
  real<lower=0, upper=1> alpha;          // Power prior parameter (degree of borrowing)

}

model {
  // Priors
  
    alpha ~ beta(1, 1);
    lambda[1] ~ gamma(alpha * D1 , alpha * T1 );  // Prior for hazard rates
    lambda[2] ~ gamma(alpha * D2 ,  alpha * T2 );
    lambda[3] ~ gamma(alpha * D3 , alpha * T3 );
   
  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);                  // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);

  // Likelihood: Poisson trick for piecewise constant hazard model
  status ~ poisson(interval_length .* lambda[interval_idx] .* exp(beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));
 
}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log(lambda[interval_idx[nn]]) + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Stan model- NPP bounded beta
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
stan.npp.bb <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)

  int<lower=0> D1;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D2;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D3;                  // Total event in each interval
 
  real<lower=0> T1;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T2;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T3;             // Total interval length within each interval

}

parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda; // Hazard rates for each interval
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2;   
  real<lower=0.05, upper=0.8> alpha;  // Bounded Power Prior parameter


}

model {
  // Priors
  
    alpha ~ beta(1, 1)T[0.05, 0.8];
    lambda[1] ~ gamma(alpha * D1 , alpha * T1 );  // Prior for hazard rates
    lambda[2] ~ gamma(alpha * D2 ,  alpha * T2 );
    lambda[3] ~ gamma(alpha * D3 , alpha * T3 );

  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);

  // Likelihood: Poisson trick for piecewise constant hazard model
  status ~ poisson(interval_length .* lambda[interval_idx] .* exp(beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));
 
}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log(lambda[interval_idx[nn]]) + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Stan model- NPP bounded weight
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
stan.npp.bw <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)

  int<lower=0> D1;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D2;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D3;                  // Total event in each interval
  real<lower=0> T1;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T2;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T3;             // Total interval length within each interval

  real mean_r;               // dissimilarity measurement
  real<lower=0> prec_r; 
  

  real<lower=0> a;        // Upper bound
  real<lower=0> b;        // Lower bound
  real<lower=0> c_low;    // Lower threshold
  real<lower=0> c_up;     // Upper threshold
  
}

parameters {
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda; // Hazard rates for each interval
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2;   
  real r;

}


transformed parameters {
  real alpha;
  
  if (fabs(r) < c_low) {
    alpha = b;
  } else if (fabs(r) > c_up) {
    alpha = a;
  } else {
    alpha = a + (b - a) * pow(1 - pow((fabs(r) - c_low) / (c_up - c_low), 2), 2);
  }
}

model {
  // Priors
  
    r ~ normal(mean_r, sqrt(1/prec_r)); // log hazard ratio
  
    lambda[1] ~ gamma(alpha * D1 , alpha * T1 );  // Prior for hazard rates
    lambda[2] ~ gamma(alpha * D2 ,  alpha * T2 );
    lambda[3] ~ gamma(alpha * D3 , alpha * T3 );

  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);

  // Likelihood: Poisson trick for piecewise constant hazard model
  status ~ poisson(interval_length .* lambda[interval_idx] .* exp(beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));
 
}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log(lambda[interval_idx[nn]]) + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# CPP - Uniform
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

stan.cpp.unb <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)

  int<lower=0> D1;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D2;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D3;                  // Total event in each interval
  real<lower=0> T1;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T2;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T3;             // Total interval length within each interval
  
}


parameters {
  vector[num_intervals] log_lambda_raw;   // Non-centered parameterization
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda_ref;  // Reference hazard rates
  real<lower=0, upper=1> alpha;       // Power prior weight
  real<lower=0> tau_log_lambda;       // Precision parameter for log_lambda
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2;   
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[num_intervals] log_lambda;
  log_lambda = log(lambda_ref) + log_lambda_raw * tau_log_lambda;
}

model {

  // Likelihood
 status ~ poisson(interval_length .* exp(log_lambda[interval_idx] + beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));

  // Priors
  log_lambda_raw ~ normal(0, 1);
  lambda_ref[1] ~ gamma(alpha * D1 , alpha * T1 );
  lambda_ref[2] ~ gamma(alpha * D2 , alpha * T2 );
  lambda_ref[3] ~ gamma(alpha * D3 , alpha * T3  );

  alpha ~ beta(fmax(log(tau_log_lambda), 1), 1);
  tau_log_lambda ~ cauchy(0, 2) T[0, ];

  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);
}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log_lambda[interval_idx[nn]] + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"



#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# CPP - bounded beta
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

stan.cpp.bb <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> n_ti;                  // Total subject-intervals
  int<lower=1> num_intervals;          // Number of hazard intervals
  int<lower=1, upper=num_intervals> interval_idx[n_ti];  // Index of interval for each subject
  vector[n_ti] interval_length;        // Length of each interval
  int<lower=0> status[n_ti];           // Event count (0 or 1, Poisson-trick)
  vector[n_ti] treat1;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)
  vector[n_ti] treat2;                  // Treatment indicator (0 or 1)

  int<lower=0> D1;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D2;                  // Total event in each interval
  int<lower=0> D3;                  // Total event in each interval
  real<lower=0> T1;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T2;             // Total interval length within each interval
  real<lower=0> T3;             // Total interval length within each interval
 }

parameters {
  vector[num_intervals] log_lambda_raw;   // Non-centered parameterization
  vector<lower=0>[num_intervals] lambda_ref;  // Reference hazard rates
  real<lower=0.05, upper=0.8> alpha;       // Power prior weight
  real<lower=0> tau_log_lambda;       // Precision parameter for log_lambda
  real beta1;                             // Treatment effect (log hazard ratio)
  real beta2;
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[num_intervals] log_lambda;
  log_lambda = log(lambda_ref) + log_lambda_raw * tau_log_lambda;
}

model {
  // Likelihood
  status ~ poisson(interval_length .* exp(log_lambda[interval_idx] + beta1 * treat1 + beta2 * treat2));

  // Priors
  log_lambda_raw ~ normal(0, 1);
  lambda_ref[1] ~ gamma(alpha * D1 , alpha * T1 );
  lambda_ref[2] ~ gamma(alpha * D2 , alpha * T2 );
  lambda_ref[3] ~ gamma(alpha * D3 , alpha * T3 );

  alpha ~ beta(fmax(log(tau_log_lambda), 1), 1)T[0.05, 0.8];
  tau_log_lambda ~ cauchy(0, 2) T[0, ];

  beta1 ~ normal(0, 5);
  beta2 ~ normal(0, 5);
}

generated quantities {
  
  vector[n_ti] log_lik;
 
  for (nn in 1:n_ti){
    log_lik[nn] = poisson_lpmf( status[nn] | exp(log_lambda[interval_idx[nn]] + log(interval_length[nn]) + treat1[nn]*beta1 + treat2[nn]*beta2));
  }
  
}
"
```

#### load data


```{r}
load(file = "data final/CALIMA_data.RData")
load(file = "data final/SIROCCO_data.RData")

ref <- sirocco %>% filter(treatment == "Placebo") %>% mutate(id = 1:n())
cur <- calima %>% mutate(id=1:n()) 

intervals <- round(quantile(c(cur$time[cur$status==1]),c(0.5,0.8)))
# 50% 80% 
# 112 234 
# 16, 32 weeks

ref_long <- survival::survSplit(formula = Surv(time, status)~., data=ref, cut=intervals) %>% mutate(interval=factor(tstart), interval_length=time-tstart) 
cur_long <- survival::survSplit(formula = Surv(time, status)~., data=cur, cut=intervals) %>% mutate(interval=factor(tstart), interval_length=time-tstart) 

# current trial: add index for interval
cur_long$Index_Interval_1 <- as.numeric(cur_long$interval==0)
cur_long$Index_Interval_2 <- as.numeric(cur_long$interval==intervals[1])
cur_long$Index_Interval_3 <- as.numeric(cur_long$interval==intervals[2])

 cur_long <- cur_long %>%
    mutate(interval_idx = recode(interval, `0` = 1, `112` = 2, `234` = 3)) %>%
    mutate(treat1 = as.numeric(cur_long$treatment=="Benra 30mg Q4W"),
           treat2 = as.numeric(cur_long$treatment=="Benra 30mg Q8W"))

# provide Dsum and Tsum for model 
ref_long_sum <- ref_long %>% group_by(interval) %>% summarize(Dsum = sum(status), Tsum=sum(interval_length))


  
 
```





#### No borrow

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data for NPP no borrowing/ unbounded/ bounded beta
data_list <- list(
    n_ti =  nrow(cur_long),
    num_intervals = length(intervals)+1,
    interval_idx = cur_long$interval_idx,
    interval_length = cur_long$interval_length,
    status = cur_long$status,
    treat1 = cur_long$treat1, 
    treat2 = cur_long$treat2 
  )

# Fit the model using rstan
  fit.no.borrow <- stan(
    model_code = stan.no.borrow,
    data = data_list,
    iter = 10000,  # Increase iterations for better convergence
    warmup = 1000,
    chains = 2,
    seed = 123,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),  # Default is 0.8, increase to 0.95 or even 0.99
    verbose = TRUE ,     # Show detailed error messages
    init = "random" 
)
  
# save(fit.no.borrow,file="example_fit_noborrow.RData")

load("example_fit_noborrow.RData")  
  
summary_stats.noborrow <- summary(fit.no.borrow)$summary
summary_stats.noborrow[1:5,] 
#                   mean      se_mean           sd         2.5%          25%          50%          75%        97.5%     n_eff      Rhat
# lambda[1]  0.002496219 3.187009e-06 0.0002705895  0.001995001  0.002308034  0.002486570  0.002674938  0.003050086  7208.672 1.0001553
# lambda[2]  0.001797576 2.519400e-06 0.0002280371  0.001391489  0.001636518  0.001785685  0.001944593  0.002276044  8192.507 1.0000668
# lambda[3]  0.001416059 2.044962e-06 0.0002105360  0.001034185  0.001270849  0.001404330  0.001550465  0.001858269 10599.424 1.0000584
# beta1     -0.478722563 1.708674e-03 0.1450172388 -0.766815508 -0.576426316 -0.477164186 -0.381048316 -0.196941920  7203.119 0.9999942
# beta2     -0.305740444 1.683418e-03 0.1394063407 -0.583099677 -0.399413279 -0.304573333 -0.210744262 -0.034833423  6857.746 1.0003206

lambda.noborrow <- summary_stats.noborrow[startsWith(rownames(summary_stats.noborrow) ,"lambda"),"mean"]
beta1.noborrow <- summary_stats.noborrow["beta1","mean"]
beta2.noborrow <- summary_stats.noborrow["beta2","mean"]
log_lik.noborrow <- summary_stats.noborrow[startsWith(rownames(summary_stats.noborrow) ,"log_lik"),"mean"]

temp_log_lik.noborrow <- rep(NA, nrow(cur_long))
for (i in 1:nrow(cur_long)){
    temp_log_lik.noborrow[i] <- dpois(cur_long$status[i],  exp(log(lambda.noborrow[cur_long$interval_idx[i]]) +log(cur_long$interval_length[i])+cur_long$treat1[i]*beta1.noborrow+cur_long$treat2[i]*beta2.noborrow), log=T)
}
pDIC.noborrow<- 2*(sum(temp_log_lik.noborrow) -sum(log_lik.noborrow))
dic.noborrow <- -2*sum(temp_log_lik.noborrow) + 2*pDIC.noborrow
dic.noborrow
# [1] 2292.44


n.ctl <- nrow(cur[cur$treat==0,])
var_target1 <- summary_stats.noborrow["beta1","sd"]^2
var_target2 <- summary_stats.noborrow["beta2","sd"]^2
ess.no.borrow1 <- n.ctl*(var_target1 / var_target1 -1) # ESS=0
ess.no.borrow1

ess.no.borrow2 <- n.ctl*(var_target2 / var_target2 -1) # ESS=0
ess.no.borrow2

```

```{r}
  # NPP unbounded

    interval_length = cur_long$interval_length,
```

#### NPP Bounded Weight

```{r}
# NPP bounded weight
ref_cur_data <- rbind.data.frame(ref, cur%>%filter(treatment=="Placebo")) %>% mutate(ref_study=(study!="CALIMA"))

fit.coxph <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ ref_study, data=ref_cur_data)
# Call:
# coxph(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ ref_study, data = ref_cur_data)
# 
#                 coef exp(coef) se(coef)     z     p
# ref_studyTRUE 0.1306    1.1395   0.1259 1.038 0.299
# 
# Likelihood ratio test=1.08  on 1 df, p=0.2989
# n= 515, number of events= 254 
  
  # Extract coefficient (log HR) and variance
  mean_r <- coef(fit.coxph)  # Log hazard ratio
  var_log_hr <- vcov(fit.coxph)  # Variance of log HR
  var.tuning <- 2.4
  prec_r <- (1/var_log_hr)/var.tuning
  
  data_npp.bw <- list(
    n_ti =  nrow(cur_long),
    num_intervals = length(intervals)+1 ,
    interval_idx = cur_long$interval_idx,
    interval_length = cur_long$interval_length,
    status = cur_long$status,
    treat1 = cur_long$treat1, 
    treat2 = cur_long$treat2,
    D1 = ref_long_sum$Dsum[1],
    D2 = ref_long_sum$Dsum[2],
    D3 = ref_long_sum$Dsum[3],
    T1 = ref_long_sum$Tsum[1],
    T2 = ref_long_sum$Tsum[2],
    T3 = ref_long_sum$Tsum[3],
    mean_r = as.numeric(mean_r),       # Example mean
    prec_r = as.numeric(prec_r),       # Example precision
    a = 0.05,
    b = 0.8,
    c_low = 0,
    c_up = 0.3
  )
  
  
  fit.npp.bw <- stan(
    model_code = stan.npp.bw,
    data = data_npp.bw,
    iter = 10000,  # Increase iterations for better convergence
    warmup = 1000,
    chains = 2,
    seed = 123,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),  # Default is 0.8, increase to 0.95 or even 0.99
    # verbose = TRUE      # Show detailed error messages
    init = "random" 
      
)
```
